title: A real drive: news on the phone, Take it, the next town (you drive, it watches)
tryitout: A real drive with DriveGen navigating
Take it on the phone while DriveGen navigates
A drive out of town with Fuel on the way

steps.say: Start navigating in DriveGen on your phone (Settings › Location › Tell my Mac where I am while driving is on), then press Enter

steps.why: Your phone's position reaches the Mac

steps.say: Drive. When a card comes with Take via …, tap it: does DriveGen re-route that way? (Enter = yes)
Out of town: did the next town, fuel or weather come, between turns and not too often? (Enter = yes)
